newsitem.title: HUNGARY: EU GRANTS HUNGARY 4.3 MLN ECU FOR BORDER UPGRADES.
newsitem.headline: EU GRANTS HUNGARY 4.3 MLN ECU FOR BORDER UPGRADES.

text.p: The European Union has granted Hungary 4.3 million Ecu under the PHARE programme to modernise four border crossings, the Finance Ministry said on Tuesday.
The PHARE programme provides technical aid to ex-communist states in central and Eastern Europe.
Hungary will match the PHARE's funding of the upgrading of the four border crossings at Gyula, Zahony, Artand and Redics, the ministry said in a statement.
The agreement was signed by Hungary's Finance Minister Peter Medgyessy and EU ambassador to Hungary Hans Beck.

Since 1993, the EU has allocated 4.45 million Ecu support within the framework of regional development programmes and 15 million Ecu under national programmes for the development of Hungarian border crossing points, the statement said.
